subject: I need to increase the size of the axis titles.

messages.author: ebf89c2162e6dab1
messages.subject: I need to increase the size of the axis titles.
parts:
Hi:
I have a problem with the function ggplot.
I need to increase the size of the axis titles.
I tried many options and have not been successful.
I send you the codes. The problem is highlighted in yellow.
Greetings


 

df <- data.frame(Año = factor(c(2001, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008)), Tasa= c(28.25,  28.54, 27.02, 25.75, 25.07, 25.23, 23.24, 22.14), se = c(1.26, 1.24, 1.18, 1.13, 1.10, 1.08, 1.02, 0.98), group = factor(c(1, 1) ) )

 

ggplot(df, aes(y=Tasa , x=Año))   +    geom_line(aes(group=group))   +    geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = Tasa+ se, ymin=Tasa- se),width=0.2, size = 0.7, position = position_dodge())    +    labs(x = 'Año', y = 'Tasa por 100.000 habitantes')    +    opts(panel.grid.major = theme_blank() , panel.grid.minor = theme_blank() , panel.background= theme_blank() , panel.border=theme_rect(colour="black") , axis.text.x = theme_text(colour = 'black', size = 15) ,   axis.text.y = theme_text(colour = 'black', size = 15) )




--
Gloria Correa Beltrán
